name: Dolphins Down Under
description: Check out the pristine Gulf Coast beaches, islands, and back bays on a Dolphin Cruise or Sunset Cruise! Join us as we experience a truly amazing adventure while searching for wild dolphins along our local bays and beaches of Orange Beach, Gulf Shores, and Perdido Key! Dolphins Down Under brings your family closer to nature, and our tour guides are there to tell you all about it. Both of our catamarans have four door-sized glass panels on the bottom of each vessel. This allows for a view of the world below, and a chance to see dolphins and other marine life as they play beneath the surface. We offer Daily Dolphin Cruises and Sunset Cruises, as well as Private Charters for special events! Each glass bottom boat cruise is its own memorable experience, and we encourage you to experience them all. Besides dolphins, you will have the chance to see osprey, great blue herons, stingrays, sea turtles, and many other marine life in our waterways. Let Dolphins Down Under be your boat and dolphin cruise connection today! For your safety and convenience, we supply life jackets for adults and children alike on all our dolphin cruises. Children 8 years of age and under are required by the United States Coast Guard to wear a life jacket. At Dolphins Down Under, safety is our number one priority. Along with safety, your comfort is also important to us. We have a snack and beverage bar, (alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks) for purchase on your cruise. For those small emergencies you may encounter onboard, fear not, we do have a marine restroom! We always appreciate your business and look forward to showing you the beautiful Alabama Gulf Coast!
